confidence_notes: Low overall. Beer, coffee, wine and the meal anchors rest on crowdsourced Expatistan and similar listings with small samples, converted at about 2,650 TZS per USD. Cocktail is inferred from the beer anchor because no Arusha cocktail price was found. Hostel and hotel anchors are holistic model estimates, not checked against live listings. The FX value comes from search-result summaries that cite RBA data; I did not read it directly from rba.gov.au, so verify it on that page before use.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city was used for the food anchors. They are Arusha-specific listing averages. Accommodation is a holistic estimate for northern Tanzanian safari-hub towns such as Moshi, with an Arusha adjustment.
